resources.name: Open-source DFT code with PAW method (e.g., GPAW)

access.notes: Agent must use an implementation that supports PBE functional, PAW method, and Grimme D2 dispersion correction. PBE pseudopotentials must be used. Quantum ESPRESSO is also acceptable.

resources.notes: The agent chooses an open-source DFT implementation capable of the required level of theory.
